content: अभिमन्त्र् €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (<ab>P.</ab> also) .²1 To consecrate or accompany with sacred hymns; पशुरसौ योऽभिमन्त्र्य कतौहतः <ls>Ak.</ls>; वामदेवाभिमन्त्रितोऽश्वः <ls>U. 2</ls>; गायत्र्या चाभिमन्त्रयेत् <ls>Y. 3. 325</ls>, <ls n="Y.">2. 102</ls>, <ls n="Y.">3. 278</ls>. .²2 To consecrate with magical formulas, charm, enchant, invoke or invite by means of charms; तदभिमन्त्रितेन चरणेन <ls>Dk. 138</ls>; पानीयैरभिमन्त्रितैः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²3 To speak to, address, invite.
